What you can get

## The deliverable is the point, not the scan.

We measure what already exists, then hand you the drawing or model your team designs and builds
against. Pick the one that fits your work.

### 2D as-built drawings and floor plans

Plans, elevations, and sections with real window and door sizes. The existing-conditions record most
renovation and residential work actually needs.

### 3D and Revit models

Scan-to-BIM models that drop into Revit or CAD, built to the level of detail your workflow calls
for.

### Matterport walkthroughs

A virtual walk of the space you can share with anyone. Walk the site from your desk instead of
driving back to it.

### Point cloud data

The raw measured capture, registered and cleaned, ready for your own team to model or measure
against.

### Sites and land

Drone and topographic capture for exteriors, roofs, acreage, and terrain, turned into site models
and surfaces.

### Objects and parts

Close-range capture of parts, fixtures, and components so fabricators can build to the real
geometry.

Not sure which one your project needs? That is our job, not yours. [Tell us the project][19] and we
sort the deliverable.

Real jobs we capture

## Scan what exists, so what you build fits the first time.

You get exact dimensions to design against. No re-measuring, no misfits, no second trip to the site.

### A commercial property going up for sale

We scanned a printing shop in about 45 minutes. The seller, the agent, and the buyer's architect all
worked from the same existing-conditions capture to plan and market what the space becomes next.

### A custom handrail built to fit a stair

Metal or hand-carved wood, a railing has to land on an existing stair exactly. Scan the stair, hand
the fabricator the geometry, and it drops in without cutting and refitting on site.

### A renovation tying into existing walls

An addition has to meet what is already there. We capture the existing structure so the new design
connects clean, instead of finding the walls are off by inches once framing starts.

### An old building with no drawings

When the original plans are long gone, we capture what is physically there and give you an accurate
as-built to design from, whether it is a historic theater or a working plant.

the fabricator the geometry, and it drops in without cutting and refitting on site.

### A renovation tying into existing walls

An addition has to meet what is already there. We capture the existing structure so the new design
connects clean, instead of finding the walls are off by inches once framing starts.

### An old building with no drawings

When the original plans are long gone, we capture what is physically there and give you an accurate
as-built to design from, whether it is a historic theater or a working plant.
